enum.name: firebolt_surface_visibility
enum.description: Passed as the visibility argument for the set_visible request.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the firebolt_surface object. This removes the association with the underlying wl_surface or hardware video surface and removes the surface from the composition.

request.name: set_name

description.summary: set the name of the firebolt_surface

request.description: Sets the name of the surface

request.name: set_visible

description.summary: set the visibility of the surface

request.description: Setting to 0 makes the surface not visible.

request.name: set_bounds
request.description:
The surface bounds of a surface is its composited pixel position and dimensions. If unset then the surface is set to the top left, with width and height that match the underlying surface dimensions.
The width and height of the effective surface bounds must be greater than zero. Setting an invalid size will raise an
invalid_size error.

request.name: set_crop

description.summary: set the cropping of the surface within the surface

request.description:
Sets the cropping of a given surface.
Cropping works on an arbitrary scale, not on pixels. The input surface is defined as a rectangle with width and height of 1.0 and therefore all cropping values should be fixed point values between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.
For example to crop the top right quarter of the video then set (x, y, width, height) to (0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.5).

request.name: set_zorder

description.summary: set the relative z-order of the surface

request.description:
Sets the z-order of the surface relative to other surfaces within the client's display.
The z-order should be in the range of 0.0 - 1.0 inclusive.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description:
Sets the opacity of the surface. It may not be possible to set the opacity on hardware video surfaces.
The opacity should be in the range of 0.0 - 1.0 inclusive.

request.name: get_properties
request.description: get the entire firebolt surface properties based on surface id.

arg.name: x
arg.summary: the left position of the surface in pixel screen coordinates

arg.name: y
arg.summary: the top position of the surface in pixel screen coordinates

arg.name: width
arg.summary: the width of the graphics surface in pixel screen coordinates

arg.name: height
arg.summary: the height of the graphics surface in pixel screen coordinates
